d:
Uttar pradesh vidhanasbha chunav men endie ke bich siton ka jald hi bantvara hoga. janta dal yunaited ki taraph se is bar bhi koshish ho rahi hai ki bijepi ke sath siton ko lekar talmel ho jae. jediyu is bar nitish kumar ki jagah nishant kumar ko chehra banakar apni takat yupi men dikhane ki taiyari kar raha hai. bihar se sate 30 siton par najar hai, jisko lekar vishesh ranniti banaee ja rahi hai.
